qcNotes:
Damaged Quantity:
Approximately 5–6
pieces
During the
inspection, a few
pavers were found to
be brittle and prone
to crumbling. The
reason is believed to
be that these pavers
were relatively dry,
which may have
occurred during the
production start-up
stage due to water
adjustment at the
beginning of
production.
In addition, loading
and unloading
activities may have
contributed to some
of the observed
damage.
A sample of the
same paver product
was subsequently
tested at the Hidd
Yard, and the
compressive
strength was found
to comply with the
applicable
standards. Based on
the test results, the
customer was
reassured and
agreed to proceed
with using the
material.
Conclusion:
At this stage, no
replacement is
required, as the
damaged quantity is
very limited and the
material has already
been used by the
customer without
any reported issues.
